From March 18, April 8, May 18-20, and May 27, 2021, representatives of the Pipeline and
Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Pipeline Safety (OPS), pursuant
to Chapter 601 of 49 United States Code (U.S.C.), inspected your records (virtually) and field
assets in Alexander, North Dakota.
As a result of the inspection, it is alleged that Dakota Midstream (DM) has committed probable
violations of the Pipeline Safety Regulations, Title 49, Code of Federal Regulations (CFR). The
items inspected and the probable violations are:

headquarters;
